unit_score: indicator strength x patient intensity x evidence reliability
combination: Use diminishing returns within independent correlation groups. Repeating the same problem must not count as many independent pieces of evidence.

confidence.correction: If there is no relevant evidence, confidence must be Low / Not assessed. Do not award full completeness merely because nothing was identified.

imbalance_gate.single_direction: If exactly one of Deficient or Excess reaches the meaningful directional threshold, select that direction and mark IMBALANCED.
imbalance_gate.both_directions: If both directions reach the meaningful directional threshold, select the stronger direction only when stronger / weaker >= 1.20; otherwise mark CONFLICTED without selecting a direction.
imbalance_gate.confidence_and_coverage: Confidence is calculated after status and coverage contributes only to confidence; neither blocks an otherwise meaningful imbalance.
imbalance_gate.eligibility: Only current confirmed or successfully clarified evidence with a valid KB indicator and chakra-direction mapping contributes to directional scores.
imbalance_gate.high_priority_single: A Strong + Severe + Confirmed unit with score >= 0.70 may be shown as a high-priority candidate, but this does not add an imbalance gate condition.
imbalance_gate.multiple_chakras: Evaluate each chakra independently; every chakra passing its directional gate may be reported.
imbalance_gate.therapist_stop: The therapist may stop at any time; stopping does not make an unsupported chakra an imbalance.
